text:
mira: heads-up — sketching a lightweight polyglot weight-IO adaptor that can stream safetensors + a small custom 'frag' bundle format. idea: per-shard read-window negotiation + an eviction-token handshake to help runtime make safe, zero-copy reads. want quick takes on safety, telemetry, and whether this fits cleanly under the loader interface.

mira: rough protocol sketch (pseudo header):
```
FRAGv1|shard_id=uuid|offset=uint64|len=uint64|check=crc32|sig=ed25519(hex)|prefetch_hint=ms
```

sam: nice. two immediate warnings: 1) merging multiple frags into one logical shard must preserve atomicity (or we need a swap/lease primitive). 2) crc32 + ed25519 double-check is fine, but want a cheap fast-fail checksum for path decisions.

jon: how does this interact with our existing index-first warmup? if adapter streams without an index we could get OOMs when the runtime expects quick lane selection.

mira: good point. plan was adapter exposes an optional index blob: either sidecar index or an inline minimal index (chunk offsets + activations map). runtime can prefer index-first if provided, fallback to sequential streaming otherwise.

anna: add prefetch_hint and evict_hint to header so scheduler can prioritize. also we should surface a per-frag telemetry tag (namespace+bundle) so we can correlate OOMs/backpressure.

lee: from infra perspective: prefer the adapter to return a capability bitmask: {index_available, signed, zero_copy_ok, streamable}. keeps loader contract small.

sam: capability mask is good. also consider a small lease handshake: runtime requests shards with lease_token; adapter returns lease + evict_token. if we try to evict while active, adapter denies until lease expires. prevents racey swapouts.

jon: cost tradeoff: streaming without index reduces latency-to-first-byte but increases worst-case memory if runtime can't pre-evict. so we should default to index-first for production routes and allow streaming for cold starts/canaries.

mira: agree. default policy = index-first; streamable adapter must advertise prefetch_budget and chunk_size so runtime can bound memory.

infra-bot: deploy/canary Mira/polyglot-loader-probe -> canary env deployed (build: b452), observe for 2h. :rocket:

anna: ops note: ensure we tag traces with header.check and capability bits (so we can slice perf by signed vs unsigned).

lee: question on verification: do we verify ed25519 on the critical path or schedule async verification?

sam: verify incrementally: cheap checksum first on critical path, full signature verif async but mark frag as untrusted until done. need fallback policy for untrusted content (e.g., deny on mismatch or serve but alert).

mira: propose flow: 1) read header + crc32 -> if passes, map pages and serve; 2) schedule ed25519 verify off-worker; 3) if verify fails, emit audit event and attempt rollback using lease/atomic-swap.

jon: rollback requires we keep previous shard around until verification closes. needs storage cost but worth it for safety.

anna: agree — cheap retention window (ttl) per-shard after swap. configurable. also emit metric: frag.verify_latency and frag.rollback_count.

sam: small API nit: adapter should return a human-friendly error for unsupported capability (e.g., "adapter: requires index-first") so callers can programmatically fallback to different model variant.

mira: noted. I'll draft an RFC that includes: header fields, capability mask, lease/evict handshake, prefetch_budget hints, verification flow, telemetry keys, and default policy (index-first with streamable opt-in).

lee: please include an explicit backward-compatibility plan for existing safetensors-only bundles. we can't force re-encoding.

mira: yes — adapter will vendor a safe, thin shim that treats safetensors as FRAGv0 with capability bits {index_available: true, signed: false, zero_copy_ok: true}.

jon: +1. also add a small stress test spec (simulate partial stream + mid-flight eviction) so we can validate lease semantics.

mira: will add tests: 1) partial-read recovery, 2) verify-failure rollback, 3) prefetched-memory bounding, 4) index-first fallback.

anna: ping me on the RFC PR for telemetry names.

sam: thanks Mira. excited to see the draft. :thumbsup:

mira: posting RFC draft in a few hours. ping @eng-ml for reviews.
